rationale: hammernik_vn-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=200, epochs=15, batch_size=2, lr=0.0003, vn_T=3, vn_n_filters=32, vn_kernel=7, vn_n_bumps=31, vn_lambda_init=0.01, vn_init=fbp, vn_dc_norm=True, vn_checkpoint=True, max_train_s=1080, rationale=iter-5 (one knob: vn_lambda_init 3.27e-4 -> 1.0e-2, ~30x). Across iters 1/3/4 the learned lambda_t stayed frozen at its ~3.25e-4 init -> regulariser dormant, result is data-consistency-dominated, hr pinned at 0.508. Hypothesis: a larger lambda_init activates the regulariser gradient so the learned filter bank engages -> hr>0.508; if it over-smooths and drops, DC-dominance is confirmed optimal.
